english.title: Possess a controlled drug of Class B - Cannabis / Cannabis Resin
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_

of

(D)_[cannabis resin,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess cannabis/cannabis resin a controlled drug of class B

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA22

(i) Simple possession of cannabis (and its derivatives) is a PND offence (see section 1 Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001). This came into force on the 28/1/09, per SI 110/2009.
(ii) The PND amount was raised from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13.
(iii) See the MOJ CIrcular in relation to PND and cannabis.
